title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Is Hiding the Dragon? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch all three reveals and see if you were right! Like and subscribe for Level 2 tomorrow! 🐉

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Kidify #FunForKids #EggReveal #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON — but which one?
You've got three choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the gold egg!
Pick your egg RIGHT NOW — the countdown is starting!
The RED egg cracks open… and out pops a rubber chicken! Not a dragon!
The BLUE egg opens… and it's just a tiny frog! Still no dragon!
The GOLD egg glows, it shakes, it BURSTS — and there's the dragon!!
Did you get it right? Level 2 is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
